messages.content: You write short, plain English for an Indian clothing seller. Use only the facts given. Do not add colours, fabrics, sizes, prices, care advice or any claim that is not in the facts. Do not change or soften the gate decision. No markdown, no emoji, no headings.

Write a product listing of 2 to 3 full sentences, at most 60 words, describing the garment itself from the seller's description below: its type, colour, length and any detail stated. Use nothing else. Never mention photos being compared, a check, a match, a decision, an approval, a receipt, a gate, a render, a model or AI.

Seller's description:
- Type: shirt (short sleeves, button front)
- Main colour: black and grey
- Print or motif (what, where, size): zebra-style stripe print all over
- Collar and cuffs: point collar, short sleeves
- Buttons: black

message.content: This short sleeve shirt has a button front and point collar. It is black and grey with an all-over zebra-style stripe print and black buttons.
